name: 道の駅 うきは
desc: 福岡県うきは市にある道の駅「うきは」は、九州の道の駅ランキングで常に上位に輝く大人気スポットです。筑後平野を一望できる小高い丘に位置し、伝統的な「くど造り」をモチーフにした木造建築が特徴です。最大の魅力は「フルーツ王国」ならではの特産品。桃、ぶどう、梨、柿、いちごなど、四季を通じて採れたての果物が豊富に並びます。地元ブランドの豚肉や朝採れ野菜も評判で、食と絶景を存分に堪能できます。
descEn: Located in Ukiha City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Ukiha" is a highly popular destination that consistently ranks at the top of Kyushu's roadside station rankings. Situated on a small hill overlooking the Chikugo Plain, its wooden architecture features a motif of traditional "Kudo-zukuri" houses. Its greatest appeal lies in the local specialties fitting of a "Fruit Kingdom." A rich variety of freshly picked fruits—including peaches, grapes, pears, persimmons, and strawberries—are available throughout the four seasons. Local brand pork and morning-harvested vegetables are also highly regarded, making it a perfect place to fully enjoy both fantastic food and spectacular views.
